name: DraftKings boundary puncture

phase_0.boundary_condition: The regulatory and cryptographic perimeter enforcing jurisdictional compliance and transactional integrity.

VINIT.justification: Void state before authentication and geo-location data are presented.

TANCH.justification: The closed boundary that contains the system and enforces legal jurisdiction.

AFWD.justification: Directed transformation of an authorized request into the active betting ledger.

AREV.justification: Reverse morphism terminating a non-compliant connection and rolling back state.

CLINK.justification: Sequential chaining of geo-fencing, identity verification, and payment checks.

IMSCRIB.justification: Self-referential record where the system recognizes and logs its own state transitions.

FSPLIT.justification: Forks the incoming request into compliant and non-compliant branches.

FFUSE.justification: Reconstitutes the unified session state from the resolved transaction branches.

EVALT.justification: Affirmative evaluation confirming regulatory compliance and sufficient funds.

EVALF.justification: Negative evaluation identifying geo-restriction or identity failure.

ENGAGR.justification: A paradice where multi-leg wagers are held simultaneously without resolution.

IFIX.justification: Permanent ROM fixation of the event into the compliance log.

phase_2.split_input: Incoming user session and transaction request
phase_2.fuse_result: Unified session state and resolved ledger

phase_3.void_description: Uninitialized session state prior to authentication and geo-location verification.
phase_3.true_description: Compliant authorized state where jurisdictional and financial validations pass.
phase_3.false_description: Non-compliant blocked state where geo-fencing or identity checks fail.
phase_3.both_description: Entangled pending settlement state where multi-leg wagers are held without resolution.

steps.domain_action: Uninitialized user session before any authentication or geo-location data is presented.
Forward morphism of the user connection request toward the validation perimeter.
Composition of geo-fencing, identity verification, and payment gateway checks.
Jurisdictional validation gate forks the request into compliant and non-compliant branches.
Affirmative evaluation of the T-arm, confirming regulatory compliance and sufficient funds.
Forward morphism of the authorized wager into the active betting ledger.
Entangled pending settlement where multi-leg wagers are held without resolution.
Negative evaluation of the F-arm, identifying geo-restriction or identity failure.
Contravariant descent of the rejected request, terminating the connection and rolling back state.
Post-incident reconciliation engine reconstitutes the unified session state from the resolved branches.
Identity imscription where the audit ledger recognizes and records its own state transition.
Permanent ROM fixation of the transaction record into the append-only compliance log.
Terminal anchor sealing the regulatory perimeter and closing the transaction cycle.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: Regulatory compliance engine translating legal jurisdictions into executable validation rules.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Encrypted WebSocket channels transmitting real-time odds and wager confirmations.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: Distributed in-memory cache for active session states and immutable append-only ledger for settled wagers.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Event-driven settlement engine resolving wagers based on official sports data feeds.
phase_5.alfs_store: Centralized compliance database and cryptographic audit trail serving as the bootstrap store.

phase_6.cycle_cost: Computational overhead of multi-factor validation and cryptographic ledger updates per transaction cycle.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Uninitialized session state with pending transaction request.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Closed regulatory perimeter with appended immutable audit record.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The validation and reconciliation cycle conserves state entropy by perfectly balancing authorized executions with rejected descents and permanent audit fixation.
